content_of_post_to_comment:
Hello, I’m not sure if this is the right place but I genuinely need advice on how to get off the internet. For some background, I was one of those chronically online kids growing up. Half of my life is probably just internet usage. I honestly feel like my mental health worsens the more I scour the internet. (I’m not blaming the internet, I just think the stuff that I view/interact with aren’t healthy for me). I don’t want to go into detail because it’s all just too embarrassing for me.

I don’t want to waste my precious time anymore just making myself more miserable. I know it’s not really realistic to be completely off the internet these days, but I really want to live life in the reality. I’d greatly appreciate if anyone has any advice for me.
comment: One thing that might help is separating internet access from the specific habits that keep pulling you back in. You don't necessarily have to disappear offline; start by removing the apps, accounts, and feeds that consistently leave you feeling worse. Replace that scrolling time with something tangible, even if it's just walking or reading. Otherwise, you can end up bored and eventually reinstall everything.
